title: urochloa notochthona
intro: Urochloa notochthona, commonly known as "Tanzania Grass", is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, pain, and inflammation. The health benefits of Urochloa notochthona include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to boost the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and modulating the immune response.
